text:
alice: FYI: scheduling `user_flags_jsonb_migration` during maintenance slot 02:00-04:00 UTC. This one is an in-place rewrite with minimal DDL but big backfill (estimated 14M rows).

deploybot: migration scheduled: id=2026-07-10-uf-jsonb, window=02-04. Preflight started. To approve: `/deploy approve 2026-07-10-uf-jsonb`

chris: Plan: convert `user_flags` text->jsonb, use rolling worker pool with shard batching. We'll run canary on 2 shards first because of volume.

andrew: Key risk: long-running VACUUMs and increased IO on primary. We'll set backfill IO limit and monitor bloat metrics.

alice: Rollback criteria: sudden host IO >85% for >5m, db locks p95 >2s for >5m, or queue processing errors >0.5% sustained 5m. Rollback involves stopping workers and restoring from pre-migration snapshot if schema is incompatible.

sre_bot: Alerts created: uf-jsonb-io, uf-jsonb-lock, uf-jsonb-queue-err. We'll auto-notify #eng-infra.

deploybot: Preflight checks OK: migrations idempotent, snapshot taken. Holdpoint for canary.

alice: Approving canary: `/deploy continue 2026-07-10-uf-jsonb --canary=shard(2)`

deploybot: Canary started at ts=1784567940 against shard-2 & shard-9. Health snapshots every 2min.

chris: Canary progress: shard-2 650k rows processed in 12min, avg 9ms/row. No IO saturation.

andrew: Observability: write_iops on primary at 62% of limit, latency normal. No long locks.

alice: Canary green. Plan to scale to 20% after 20m. Leave the IO cap in place.

deploybot: scaling to 20% at ts=1784568120. Auto-throttle engaged, estimated completion 7h.

chris: Note for release notes: internal-only column change, clients unaffected. Will post a runbook snippet for oncall.

alice: Marking post-rollout watch: 60m. Good luck. :rocket:
